name: Sigvard Bernadotte
contribution: A member of the Swedish Royal Family and a successful industrial designer.

checks.lead: Sigvard Oscar Fredrik, Prince Bernadotte, Count of Wisborg (7 June 1907 – 4 February 2002) born as, and until 1934 known as, Prince Sigvard of Sweden, Duke of Uppland, was a member of the Swedish Royal Family and a successful industrial designer.
